OSAPP says transferring Pisa prison rioters merely shifts the problem

October 5, 2026 Dr. Michael Lee – Health Editor Health

Four Prison Riots And Cell Transfers At Don Bosco

On October 5, 2026, a violent insurrection at the Don Bosco prison in Pisa resulted in four criminal arrests, the formal identification of 16 other participants, and the immediate dispersal of the primary suspects across four separate correctional facilities, according to reporting by lanazione.it. The uprising featured barricades, explicit threats, thrown objects, and ignited furniture inside the detention unit. Investigators identified four inmates as the main instigators of the unrest, which culminated in cell raids and a coordinated law enforcement response by the Polizia Penitenziaria.

Journalism training courses

The Tech TL;DR:

  • Four inmates accused of orchestrating the Pisa prison riot were transferred to separate penitentiaries in Massa, Prato, Livorno, and Sollicciano following judicial orders issued by Gip Vatrano.
  • The Organizzazione Sindacale Autonoma Polizia Penitenziaria (Osapp) criticized the state’s reliance on simple prisoner relocations, arguing that transferring high-risk inmates merely shifts operational dangers between institutions rather than resolving systemic vulnerabilities.
  • Court documents reveal that one participant allegedly broadcast live footage of the barricades from cell 48 directly to TikTok, highlighting acute enforcement gaps regarding contraband communication devices inside correctional blocks.

Contrasting Views On High-Risk Inmate Management

Discover more
news sources
journalism
Newspaper subscriptions

While judicial authorities rely on immediate geographic separation to restore baseline security, union leadership argues that standard inmate transfers fail to address the root systemic failures governing high-risk populations. Leo Beneduci, general secretary of Osapp, stated in lanazione.it that the prison system suffers from a profound operational contradiction, noting that while the Polizia Penitenziaria requires adequate equipment—such as taser deployment tools to suppress active violence—the foundational issue lies in a flawed central command structure that assigns and relocates dangerous offenders without sufficient preventive controls. According to Beneduci, the prison administration relies too heavily on routine transfers rather than enforcing stricter legal instruments such as special surveillance regimes authorized under penal law provisions.

Court Separates Don Bosco Uprising Leaders into Regional Facilities

The judicial fallout from the Don Bosco uprising led to distinct containment strategies for each of the four designated leaders. Prosecutor Miriam Pamela Romano secured custody orders from Gip Vatrano, separating the suspects into distinct regional facilities. Ilber Arshi, a 39-year-old Albanian national represented by attorney Massimo Landi, was moved to the Massa facility. Jerson German Bolanos, a 39-year-old Colombian represented by Ivo Gronchi, was assigned to Prato. Daniel Myrtaj, a 24-year-old Albanian represented by Sabrina Del Fio, was transferred to Le Sughere in Livorno. Andrea Petroniq, a 43-year-old Albanian represented by Luisa Renzo, was placed in Sollicciano. All four face formal charges of property damage, while Myrtaj faces an additional count of illicitly possessing a communication device used to stream the revolt online.

Wider Regional Pressures Across Tuscan Facilities

The transfer of the Pisa detainees intersects with broader systemic strain across the regional correctional network. This influx has severely intensified overcrowding and institutional friction across Tuscan penitentiaries. Osapp noted that the Pisa facility alone lost 50 operational spaces within the affected section due to structural damage sustained during the arson and riots, compounding the logistical challenges faced by regional administrators.

Daniel Myrtaj Used Contraband Phone to Broadcast to TikTok

Digital documentation of the insurrection surfaced in real time via social media platforms. Court filings detailed by lanazione.it establish that Daniel Myrtaj utilized a contraband mobile phone from inside cell 48 to transmit live video feeds of the barricades and ongoing disturbances to TikTok. The broadcast reached thousands of users before authorities regained control of the section. The discovery of unauthorized communication hardware inside a secure detention block proves that electronic surveillance and contraband interdiction protocols within high-security units are still failing.
